Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
We’re AD/01, the tech studio that builds the future of food retail. Whether it’s in-store aisles, online baskets, or behind-the-scenes operations, we innovate the daily food experiences for farmers and families, grandmas and greengrocers, and pickers and packers alike. 
 We’re part of the Ahold Delhaize network, one of the world’s largest global food retail groups and a leader in both supermarkets and e-commerce. With 19 strong local brands in Europe, the United States, and Indonesia, we create a meaningful difference for our customers, our people, and the world around us. And we’re looking for the freshest minds excited to create the recipe for change.
 Your new role and environment. 
 As a Mobile QA Lead, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our React Native mobile applications used across several Ahold Delhaize brands in Europe.
 You will act as a lead tester across Continuous Delivery teams and projects, supporting both iOS and Android platforms within a modern white-label architecture. The platform is built using advanced engineering practices and progressive technical approaches, including Design Systems, performance measurement strategies, and strong architectural governance.
 You will collaborate closely with developers, Product Managers, automation teams, regression teams, and business stakeholders to ensure high testing standards and successful product delivery.
 Key responsibilities of your role. 
Perform functional testing for React Native mobile applications on both iOS and Android 
Create and maintain test cases, test scenarios, and test scripts 
Coordinate and guide testing activities across multiple Mobile App delivery teams and projects 
Participate in test scope preparation for regression team and act as key point of contact for Mobile App related test topics
Collaborate with developers, Product Managers, automation teams, and other stakeholders to ensure comprehensive testing coverage 
Report, triage, and track defects across Mobile App delivery teams, projects & Regression teams
Ensure testing activities are completed on time and aligned with quality standards 
Participate in production delivery activities and business UAT sessions 
Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, testing standards, and release quality 
 Technical Landscape 
React Native mobile applications 
White-label architecture 
CI/CD delivery model 
Documentation-driven engineering approach (ADR, TDD, HLD, INFO) 
JIRA & Zephyr 
GraphQL integrations 
Multi-brand eCommerce ecosystem
 What’s in it for you? 
 We ask a lot. (We’re looking for the best, after all). But we offer a lot, too. 
 So, what do we have in store for you? We offer flexible hours and a hybrid working model, allowing you to work both from home and at the office. We provide competitive benefits to support health, well-being and your professional growth. This includes: a significant budget on the benefit platform and a yearly bonus. At AD01 we welcome everyone, just the way you are, and encourage individual growth with valuable opportunities and a worldwide across-brand network.
 Requirements. 
 Must have requirements 
5+ years of experience in Mobile Testing 
Experience testing mobile applications on both iOS and Android platforms 
Strong experience creating test cases and test scripts 
Experience with: 
Functional Testing 
System Integration Testing 
Compatibility Testing 
Regression Testing 
Understanding of CI/CD processes and release flows 
Experience using tools such as JIRA and Zephyr 
 Nice to have requirements 
Experience with GraphQL and Bloomreach 
Knowledge of Accessibility (A11y) testing for mobile applications 
Exposure to React Native ecosystem and modern mobile delivery practices 
 It goes without saying that so-called ‘soft skills’ are just as important as their ‘hard’ cousins. We highly value: 
Good communication skills and fluent English
Ability to collaborate with both internal teams and vendors
Comfortable working in a multicultural, international environment
Proactive mindset and willingness to continuously learn and improve
 Apply now 
 If you’re excited to help us grow, then please apply now. If you feel like you might not tick all the boxes but have the skills and personality we’re looking for, then please also apply now!
 Got questions? Don’t be shy. Loredana Danila, at loredana.danila@ad01.com, has answers.
 For us, diversity means being inclusive of thoughts and skills, generational differences, LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, disabilities, nationalities and more. We accept everyone for who they are.
